name: Single-Leg Stretch
description: Head and shoulders curled up, draw one knee in toward your chest while the other leg reaches long, then switch.

source.note: Classic Pilates mat exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie on your back, curl your head and shoulders up.
Draw your right knee in and extend your left leg to about 45°.
cues: Hands on the bent leg: outside hand at the ankle, inside hand at the knee.
Keep your trunk still as the legs switch.

prescription.note: Move with your breath, slowly and with control.

keyframes.name: Right knee in
keyframes.cue: Draw your right knee in, left leg long.

keyframes.name: Left knee in
keyframes.cue: Switch: left knee in, right leg long.
